tools.name: search_yachts
tools.description: Use it when the person describes the yachts they want: where, when, how many people, a size, a type or a budget. Pass each wish as its typed filter (a list is any of its values; every filter must hold), and from / to whenever they gave exact days. With dates every row is free for that stay and carri

tools.name: get_yacht
tools.description: Use it once the person names or picks one yacht from a search_yachts or best_deals answer: pass its page link, exactly as that answer returned it, as id. It answers the yacht's facts and terms as the source states them (packages, included, required and optional extras, deposit, check-in days and tim

tools.name: price_range
tools.description: Use it when the person asks what a stay costs and has no exact days or yacht yet. Pass the place they named (in words, or a place value an invalid_place answer listed), the month and the party, and one type if they gave it. It answers the range of open departures there (p25, median and p75, in minor

tools.name: best_deals
tools.description: Use it when the person asks for deals, specials, discounts or last-minute offers. It answers discounted departures of this site's yachts, read from the live inventory: only a discount the source itself states (a special, or a price under its list price), never a computed gap; by default from tomorro

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Use it only after the person chose one or more yachts from a search_yachts, best_deals or get_yacht answer, gave their days and party, and said yes to a written quote: ask them before you call it. Pass the page links exactly as those answers returned them, the days, the party and anything they want

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "best_deals" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
